modules.name: Scanner
modules.description: The sound of an MRI scanner from the inside: ten real pulse sequences (localiser, T1, T2, FLAIR, gradient echo, EPI, diffusion, angio, silent, prescan) through three tuned coils, the cold-head pump and the bore, with earplugs and body sound; a whole-exam session mode; gradient waveforms as CV

modules.name: Bore Room
modules.description: Reverb modelled on the inside of an MRI scanner's tube: wall flutter, cross and length modes from the bore size (head coil to 70 cm wide bore), a short dark tail, the room through the open ends, earplugs/headphones and body sound
